answer.answer: PMJDY provides universal banking services for every unbanked adult in the country, including basic savings bank accounts, access to credit, remittances, insurance, and pension services [E01]. From the same ministry (Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services), the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is the programme that finances income-generating micro-enterprises, facilitating micro credit/loans up to Rs. 20 lakhs to non-farm sector income generating activities [E03].
